TS: the TS is not a formal term sheet. It is a Citigroup "Revolving Lender Presentation" dated April 2026, with a Company Authorization Letter dated April 30, 2026. The economic terms are on PDF p.10 (Executive Summary) and PDF p.11 (Summary of Indicative Terms, headed "Indicative Pricing"). PDF p.12-13 cover sources and uses and the timeline. The rest is disclaimers, Q1'26 financials and contacts. The p.11 pricing grid and the p.12 tables are garbled in the text extraction. The relational symbols in the grid were lost in extraction ("<" survived; the inclusive symbols did not), so the tiers were read as >=3.50x / <3.50x & >=2.50x / <2.50x & >=1.50x / <1.50x. That reading is supported by the tier structure: the upper bounds are strict ("<3.50x", "<2.50x"), so the lower bounds must be inclusive to leave no gap. It also matches the CA. The TS PDF itself (PDF 1.6 with compressed object streams) could not be rendered to confirm the glyphs.

CA: the CA is Amendment No. 9 to Credit Agreement, dated May 14, 2026, between APi Group DE, Inc. (Borrower), APi Group Corporation (Holdings) and Citibank, N.A. (Administrative and Collateral Agent). It is an Incremental Amendment under Section 2.14. It does three things:
- (a) sets up Refinancing Incremental Revolving Credit Commitments plus a $250,000,000 Incremental Revolving Credit Facility, for $1,000,000,000 total revolving commitments;
- (b) refinances all existing term loans with $2,157,391,086.86 of Amendment No. 9 Term Loans;
- (c) attaches the conformed Amended Credit Agreement as Exhibit A (PDF p.31-255).
The original agreement is dated October 1, 2019 and was amended nine times. Schedule I (lender allocations and L/C commitments) is on PDF p.29. The reconciliation is against the agreement as amended.

Limitations and review notes:
- The CA PDF was regenerated with ReportLab and is entirely black text. In the extracted .txt, deleted (strike-through) and inserted (underlined) text run together, for example "0.500.375%" and "$750,000,0001,000,000,000". Amendment Section 2(b) describes insertions as blue double-underlined; the regenerated PDF draws single lines.
- pdftoppm was not available. The reviewer independently decoded the ReportLab content streams (read-only, standard-library Python) and matched each drawn line to text-run positions using the embedded TrueType width tables. A line about 2.6pt above the baseline is a strike; a line about 2pt below is an underline. This independently confirmed the following:
  - PDF p.44: the RCF margin grid is unamended apart from replacing the "<"/">" symbols with words. Clause (b) keeps the initial 1.50%/0.50%, with only the reference date changed to Amendment No. 9.
  - PDF p.45: commitment fee 0.375% initially; then 0.375% above 2.75x and 0.25% at or below 2.75x. The old 0.50%/0.375% text is struck.
  - PDF p.78: commitments of $1,000,000,000, with $750,000,000 struck.
  - PDF p.79: the 2021 Incremental Term Loan springing-maturity proviso is struck.
  - PDF p.204-205: the Section 8.02(p) ratios moved from 3.25/3.50/3.75x to 3.75/4.00/4.25x.
  - PDF p.29: Schedule I row alignment of lenders to amounts.
  - No substantive strikes on the other pages relied on (p.42-43, 48, 50, 61, 74, 80, 107, 122-123, 132-141, 144-146, 154, 158).
- Caveats on the decoding: cross-references and some emphasis words (for example "provided") are also underlined in the regenerated PDF, so an underline alone does not prove insertion. Some genuinely new text (for example the swingline definitions on PDF p.109-110) carries no underline.
- Upfront fees are not in the CA. Exhibit A Section 2.09(b) refers to fees "separately agreed upon in writing". Amendment No. 9 Section 4(c)(ii) makes payment of fees separately agreed with the Lead Arrangers a closing condition. No fee letter was provided.
- The initial-period mechanics differ between margin and commitment fee. The margin is fixed at Level 3 until the Compliance Certificate for the first fiscal quarter after May 14, 2026 (Q2 2026). The commitment fee is fixed at 0.375% until the certificate for the first full fiscal quarter (likely Q3 2026). Certificates are due within 60 days of quarter end (Sections 7.01(b) and 7.02(a)).
- Schedules other than Schedule I (for example Schedule 2.01 and 11.02) were not reviewed.
- Covenant, guarantor, security and negative-covenant terms in the TS (PDF p.11) are outside attribute group A and were not reconciled here. The TS's $500mm senior unsecured debt is a separate issuance outside the CA (noted in X01).
